source: Fictional climbing club committee meeting (English) written for Task Q (scripts/notes-eval.ts). Fictional club and people; no real meeting.
traps: Open day proposed for Saturday 7 March, moved to Sunday 15 March before it is decided.
Tom says he will email the sponsors, then hands it to Priya (final owner Priya).
Marcus 'might look into' a council youth sports fund, 'can't promise anything' (not an action).
The logo is explicitly NOT decided; vote at the next meeting (allowed only as a deferral).
Casual commitments ('Yep, on it', 'I'll print the sign') are real actions.
Amounts in words (twelve and a half thousand / twelve thousand five hundred kronor).

decisions.text: Buddy check before every climb is a club rule.
Up to 12 500 kr for new ropes and quickdraws.
The membership fee stays the same next year.

action_items.text: Send the logo drafts to the committee

must_not.text: Open day on the 7th (the first proposal) as a decision
Sponsor emails with the old owner (Tom)
Council youth sports fund ('can't promise anything') as an action
A logo choice as a decision (only a deferral to the next meeting is allowed)
